falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 swing low invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 78% similarity to bottom_2024_aug required holding that support level as the defining structure of that bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 38 already indicates elevated but contained stress; sustained VIX above 35 confirms genuine panic rather than the controlled capitulation the pattern requires, breaking the bottom formation mechanics

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts deeper than -50 basis points and holds for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with curve steepening as a recovery signal; renewed deepening inversion contradicts the macro relief narrative embedded in the pattern and confirms recession escalation rather than soft landing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
